**

Don Danilo’s Pizza in Pertisau

** Indulge in authentic Italian flavors right in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps! **Don Danilo’s Pizza** in **Pertisau am Achensee** offers a cozy escape with its rustic charm and delicious wood-fired pizzas. Whether you crave a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Salami**, or a gourmet **Diavola**, every bite is a taste of Italy—just steps away from the breathtaking scenery of **Achensee**. After your meal, warm up with a **Kaiserschmarrn** or a creamy **Apfelstrudel** for dessert. The friendly atmosphere and generous portions make this a must-visit spot for families, couples, and pizza lovers alike. Perfect for a relaxed lunch or a casual dinner, **Don Danilo’s Pizza** is your go-to for authentic Italian cuisine in the stunning backdrop of **Tirol**. Don’t miss out—visit us in **Pertisau** and let the flavors transport you!
